title: Banana Peel on Your Wrinkles? The Trick Nobody Over 60 Talks About
description:
The exact method, as promised - so you are not pausing and scribbling on the back of an envelope.

READ THIS FIRST - THE PATCH TEST
Banana cross-reacts with latex. Ever reacted to latex gloves, party balloons, avocado, chestnut or kiwi? This one may not be for you. Tape a small square of peel inside your forearm and leave it 24 hours before it goes near your face. Every time, not just the first.

PICK THE RIGHT BANANA
- Yellow, with a few brown freckles. NOT the brown, heavily speckled, overripe one: a peel that has gone brown has already spent the thing you want.
- Wash it first, warm water, both sides. The skin is the sprayed half - the fruit inside is protected, which is what a peel is for.

THE METHOD
1. Tear off a piece about the size of two postage stamps and use it WITHIN A FEW MINUTES. The torn edge starts converting the useful compounds into brown pigment the moment it meets the air.
2. PRESS the wet white inner side against the skin. Move it slowly. Do not rub, do not scrub, do not massage. Nothing a dermatologist would call friction.
3. On the BONE under your eye - the ridge you can feel with a fingertip - and no further in. Never in the soft hollow, never on the lid or lash line.
4. Seven or eight minutes, and off while it is still visibly WET. Do not let it dry.
5. Rinse with plain cool water. Nine seconds, no soap, no washcloth, no rubbing.
6. On damp skin, put a plain occlusive over the top - the cheapest tub in your bathroom cupboard.
7. Every OTHER night. Your skin needs some hours in the plain open air.
8. Need a second piece? Tear a FRESH one, never the piece that has been lying on the counter.

Ripe, not brown. Fresh, not waiting. Pressed, not rubbed. Wet, never dry.

WHY NOT TO LET IT DRY
This is the instruction almost every video gives, and it is the one that hurt me. As the pectin and fruit sugars dry they contract - that is the tightening everyone chases, and it is a film on top of your face, not a change to the line underneath. Worse, dried banana sugar does not rinse. It goes tacky, then gluey, and you end up working at it with your fingertips exactly where the skin is thinnest. That is a mechanical injury, and it is the fastest way to age a face overnight.

WHAT IS ACTUALLY IN THERE
The skin runs four to five times higher in total phenolics than the fruit, plus potassium, silicon, carotenoids, pectin and natural waxes - and dopamine, at 80 to 560 mg per 100 g of peel against 2.5 to 10 mg in the fruit. It is a powerful antioxidant the plant uses to protect its own tissue, and it is water soluble - which is why the wet inner face of a FRESH peel is the whole delivery.

WHAT TO EXPECT, AND WHEN
- Nights 1-2: nothing. A change on day two is the film, not your skin.
- Nights 5-7: the backs of the hands - dullness and the fine papery creasing first.
- Week 2: evenness, and morning puffiness down to about twenty minutes from two hours.
- Nothing after three weeks? Then it is not for your skin. Stop.

THE HONEST LIMITS
It will not remove a wrinkle. Nothing pressed onto the surface reaches a fold made of forty years of expression and gravity. The lines from my nose to my mouth, and the vertical one between my eyebrows, are exactly where they were. What changed was the surface - texture, evenness, the papery look on the backs of my hands, and the morning puffiness. That is the whole honest list.

This is not sun protection. If you only ever do one thing for ageing skin, it is the sun.

SAFETY - please do not skip
- Patch test, 24 hours, inside the forearm. Every time.
- Latex, avocado, chestnut or kiwi sensitivity - not for you.
- Wash the peel. That is where the fungicide sits.
- On the bone, never the hollow. Never rubbed, with anything.
- Broken, cracked, eczema or angry skin - not right now.
- On a prescription retinoid or acid? Ask whoever prescribed it first.

I am not a doctor and this is not medical advice. It is what I did for fourteen nights, what changed, and what did not. If something on your skin worries you, get it looked at.

Tell me in the comments what you were taught to throw away - whatever went straight in the bin in your mother's kitchen without anybody ever asking a question about it.
